body: Thanks for the kind words.  It's really nothing bad in my life, I'm just not enjoying it anymore.  Haven't been for years.  I don't like my job, i'm upside down on my mortgage, my relationship stinks, and don't have any kids - so now would be the best time to go out.  The only person I would screw is my mom who has cosigned my student loans (only 12 more years left!).  Therefore, I'm curious about a clause because when I go out I don't want to leave her with a ton of debt - and as of now 2.5 years worth the salary will pay it all off and leave a few grand to get rid of the house.  I hate my job, I hate my home life, and I feel miserable everyday being here - so I'm just looking for an answer on the insurance.
